title: Interpolation, command substitution and variable expansion as credential values
summary: Values such as $(registryPassword), $(pass show benchmark/database), #{ENV['DB_PASSWORD']}, {env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY} and ${DATABASE_PASSWORD} assigned to credential-named keys across Azure pipelines, shell, Ruby and configuration formats.
rationale: Interpolation defers the secret to run time. Flagging the syntax flags every correctly written pipeline and every shell script that reads a secret from a store.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. Each value is an interpolation form in its language and holds no secret bytes.

incidents.summary: Preserve Windows environment references and SQL bind parameters in contextual detection
